# Frederick Armando — Lead Product Designer

> Portfolio of Frederick Armando, Lead Product Designer focused on complex digital products, AI-powered experiences, mobile UX, B2B/B2C services, accessibility and product strategy.

Frederick Armando is a Lead Product Designer based in France. His work focuses on transforming complex user, business and technical constraints into clear, usable and measurable product experiences.

Key areas:
- Product strategy
- Conversational AI
- Mobile UX
- B2B/B2C products
- Accessibility
- Design systems
- UX research and product discovery

## Core pages

- [Home](https://frederickarmando.fr/): Overview, positioning and selected entry points.
- [Profile](https://frederickarmando.fr/profil): Career overview, skills and product design focus.
- [Methods](https://frederickarmando.fr/methodes): Product design approach from framing to measurement.
- [Projects](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets): Selected case studies and product work.
- [Contact](https://frederickarmando.fr/contact): Contact information and collaboration availability.

## Case studies

- [Michelin Tire Assistant](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/tire-assistant): Case study about transforming a passive B2C chatbot into a proactive engagement and conversion lever.
